pairs: Ecce autem in Ephraim orta est seditio:
And behold, a sedition rose up in Ephraim.
Then, while passing by toward the north,
Quare vadens ad pugnam contra filios Ammon,
“When you were going to fight against the sons of Ammon,
why were you unwilling to summon us,
so that we might go with you?
Therefore, we will burn down your house.”
Disceptatio erat mihi et populo meo contra filios Ammon vehemens:
“I and my people were in a great conflict against the sons of Ammon.
so that you might offer assistance to me.
And you were not willing to do so.
posui animam meam in manibus meis,
I put my life in my own hands,
and I crossed to the sons of Ammon,
et tradidit eos Dominus in manus meas.
and the Lord delivered them into my hands.
ut adversum me consurgatis in prælium?
that you would rise up in battle against me?”
Vocatis itaque ad se cunctis viris Galaad,
calling to himself all the men of Gilead,
And the men of Gilead struck down Ephraim,
and he lives in the midst of Ephraim and Manasseh.”
And the Gileadites occupied the fords of the Jordan,
along which Ephraim was to return.
Cumque venisset ad ea de Ephraim numero,
And when anyone from the number of Ephraim had arrived,
“I beg that you permit me to pass,”
the Gileadites would say to him,
which is translated as ‘ear of grain.’
eadem littera spicam exprimere non valens.
not being able to express the word for an ear of grain in the same letters.
Statimque apprehensum jugulabant in ipso Jordanis transitu.
And immediately apprehending him, they would cut his throat,
Et ceciderunt in illo tempore de Ephraim quadraginta duo millia.
at the same crossing point of the Jordan. And in that time of Ephraim, forty-two thousand fell.
Judicavit itaque Jephte Galaadites Israël sex annis:
And so Jephthah, the Gileadite, judged Israel for six years.
ac sepultus in civitate sua Galaad.
and he was buried in his city in Gilead.
Post hunc judicavit Israël Abesan de Bethlehem:
After him, Ibzan of Bethlehem judged Israel.
qui habuit triginta filios, et totidem filias,
He had thirty sons, and the same number of daughters,
whom he sent away to be given to husbands.
et ejusdem numeri filiis suis accepit uxores,
And he accepted wives for his sons of the same number,
And he judged Israel for seven years.
and he was buried in Bethlehem.
After him succeeded Elon, a Zebulunite.
And he judged Israel for ten years.
and he was buried in Zebulun.
Post hunc judicavit Israël Abdon filius Illel Pharathonites:
After him, Abdon, the son of Hillel, a Pirathonite, judged Israel.
all riding upon seventy young donkeys.
And he judged Israel for eight years.
ac sepultus in Pharathon terræ Ephraim,
and he was buried at Pirathon, in the land of Ephraim,
